Combine the reusable-result cache with quality processing in one extraction configuration.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"enable_quality_processing\":true,\"use_cache\":true}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().qualityScore)
}
```
